---
title: "ukhsa_data_analysis"
author: "Luxi Cai"
---

This code aims to visualise the Weekly laboratory notifications of Invasive group A streptococcal infection (iGAS) for England.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
iGAS <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-iGAS.csv")
gt(head(iGAS))

```


```{r}
ggplot(iGAS, aes(
  x = date, 
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "green") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Laboratory notifications") +
  ggtitle("Weekly laboratory notifications of iGAS in England")
```
